comment: Known interrupt-matrix failures, each pinned to its expected signature (plan-interrupt-harness r4 §6.3). A row whose failure matches is KNOWN, not FAIL; a different failure is still FAIL; a row here that now passes is FIXED, and the run fails until this entry is removed in the same change as the fix (they flip together). Each entry names its finding and the owner who is fixing it.

entries.finding: F3 (Ctrl-C not delivered during a prompt input)
entries.fix: E3: prompt inputs in a worker

entries.signature: no KeyboardInterrupt|did not take the next input

entries.finding: F4: the GF(32003) rank cliff (pilot 4: s = 388 in 0.243 s, s = 409 over 60 s; the 400x401 nmod_echelon boundary)
slot 5: a pending Ctrl-C is never raised after a non-polling call when no loop follows (pyjs polls only at back-edges; same root as E13g)
entries.fix: a poll at host-call returns or statement boundaries
entries.routed: python, with magma's S plan (@sagebrush, Oct 25)
